**Dispatch order** — `domain:ui` seat, PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`. Branch: `claude/issue-6465-stale-typecheck-headers`.

**Assignee set by the PM at dispatch.** The dev-side contract and both repos' CLAUDE.md currently disagree about who owns that field (objectstack#12520); until that is resolved I set it here so the card never reads as available while claimed. Post your claim comment as normal — the session ID in it is the ownership token, not this field.

### Triage's ruling, verbatim

> Same defect class as #6426, whose fix has now MERGED (that card closed 02:34Z today) — its PR is the template: comment-only edits plus an empty-frontmatter changeset, with per-file confirmation via `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` exactly as this card prescribes (the 41/41 coverage reading is package-level; confirm per file before rewording its header). One card, one dispatch — app-shell and core are independent surfaces but the change is comment-only, so splitting buys nothing.
>
> Priority note inside the lane: two of the headers actively route authors AWAY from compile-time assertions that would in fact be checked — the same prescriptive-and-false shape that justified #6426 — so this is drift that changes author behaviour, not cosmetics.

That second paragraph is why this is worth a dev rather than a backlog entry: a header that tells the next author "a `@ts-expect-error` here would be read by no compiler" is not stale trivia, it is an instruction to stop writing assertions that would in fact hold.

### Premise re-verified on current `main` — the card measured at `e929c562a` and main has moved a long way since

Checked just now:

- `tsconfig.typetests.json`: **0 files exist** repo-wide.
- Positive control for that zero: `tsconfig.test.json` returns **36**. So the search space is real and the zero is a zero, not a pattern that could not match.

The card's two claims hold.

### ⭐ The card's file list is incomplete — measure the population, do not take the list

The card enumerates roughly ten sites. A count of `tsconfig.typetests.json` citations across `app-shell` and `core` on current `main` also returns:

```
packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/color-variant-field.labelling.test.tsx : 1
```

which is **not** in the card's list. There may be more. **Derive the full population yourself** — both claims, both packages — and report your count against the card's. If they differ, yours wins and say so. A comment-only sweep that fixes the enumerated ten and leaves an eleventh is precisely how this defect class regenerates: the next reader counts the fixed ones and concludes the surface was swept.

### The per-file confirmation is the actual work

Triage is explicit that the 41/41 coverage reading is **package-level** and does not license rewording any individual header. Before you rewrite a file's header to say "this file is compiled", confirm **that file** with `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` — the way #6426 did.

This matters more than it sounds: you are replacing a false claim with a positive one. A wrong "this is compiled" is worse than the wrong "this is not compiled" you are removing, because it invites authors to rely on enforcement that is not there. If a file turns out **not** to be in the include set, that is a finding — say so and leave that header alone rather than making it true-sounding.

### Scope

Comment-only, per triage, plus an empty-frontmatter changeset (the #6426 PR is the template — read it). ⛔ Do not change any assertion, directive, or test body. If a header's prose is wrong *because the assertion beneath it is wrong*, that is a different card — file it.

### File face

The header sites you measure across `packages/app-shell/src/**` and `packages/core/src/**`, plus the changeset. Nothing else.

### In-flight, do not touch

#6522 (`plugin-designer`) · #6524 (`packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.objectPayloadFieldsMap.test.ts`) · #6471 (`plugin-gantt`, `packages/types`), plus open PRs #6539 (`examples/`), #6540 (`app-shell` — `providers/`, `console/AppContent.tsx`, `index.ts`, `views/RecordFormPage.tsx`) and #6542 (`packages/types` feedback, `packages/components`). Measured disjoint from the header sites above; ⛔ if your population turns out to include any file in that list, stop and report rather than editing it.

Note `views/metadata-admin/` is free again as of `11f23e9a5` (#6329 landed), which is why this card is dispatchable now and was not an hour ago.
